character: Two large mountains, Whistler and Blackcomb, linked by the Peak 2 Peak Gondola above a pedestrian village in the Coast Mountains about 125 km north of Vancouver. It is one of the largest ski areas in North America, with alpine bowls, glaciers and over 1,600 m of vertical.
learning: Reference note: beginner zones sit at mid-mountain on Whistler (around Olympic Station) and near the Blackcomb base, and lessons run through the resort snow school. Confirm current learning areas and lesson products.

research.confidenceNotes: Upgraded on 2026-09-30 from reference-only using batched web searches (search-result summaries; page fetching is blocked, so no official page was read directly). Search-summary facts: planned 2026-27 opening, terrain/lift stats and uphill capacity, 2026-27 advance-style prices and season-pass link. Still Piste reference data (unverified): identity, coordinates and weather points, operator, elevations, features, airport drive estimates and transfers. Summaries sometimes blend several result pages, so the source URL on each fact group is the most specific result that carried it — confirm at source before relying on it. Snow-report, lift-status and trail-map links follow the URL pattern shared by all Vail Resorts sites (terrain-and-lift-status.aspx and mountain-info.aspx were seen in results for sister resorts); they were not individually opened.
